name: resonant-quantum-mechanics
description: Validate OpenQASM 3 circuits, repair supported source errors, check circuit equivalence or transformation preservation, and run supported local simulations. Use supplied circuit source or supported circuit artifacts when you need validation findings, a checked candidate, or simulation evidence. Execution requires an authorized RQM account, a valid owner-saved spending policy and an explicitly approved price ceiling. Results are limited to the returned service contract; no QPU execution, live-provider access or physical hardware-performance evidence.
